purpose: Teach: 櫻井/杉本/鳩山/齋藤/佐伯/中谷/中井/川島

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、櫻井刑事の現場対応も評価されますね
lines.en: The police are quite impressed with Detective Sakurai's on-site response, aren't they?
lines.style: Measured, conversational. Light acknowledgment on the statement. Steady pace, slightly approving tone. Matter-of-fact observation without flattery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人杉本氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: And they've been careful taking the statement from witness Sugimoto, haven't they?
lines.style: Continuing the same level tone. Slight emphasis on 'careful' — noting procedural diligence. Same tempo, consistent professional register.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、政界の鳩山系列の関係事案も担当されますね
lines.en: I see they're also handling the political connections to the Hatoyama faction on this case.
lines.style: Slightly more weight here — acknowledging complexity. Still measured but with a trace more deliberation. Not rushed. Professional awareness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者齋藤氏の供述を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: They've got witness Saito's statement organized now, is that right?
lines.style: Light, checking in. Casual question cadence at the end. Warm but not familiar. Simple, direct phrasing that expects confirmation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者佐伯の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: And they've confirmed the suspect Saeki's prior convictions, yes?
lines.style: Focused, businesslike. Quick acknowledgment of completed work. Clipped, efficient pacing. Professional affirmation without sentiment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、心理士中谷様にご助言を仰がれますね
lines.en: They're consulting with psychologist Nakatani for guidance on this, I understand?
lines.style: Respectful reference to the expert. Slight lift on the title 'psychologist.' Warm, acknowledging specialist input. Measured and deferential.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人中井氏のご証言を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: They've also got witness Nakai's testimony properly documented, haven't they?
lines.style: Checking another box. Even, procedural tone. Same professional cadence as the earlier statements. Matter-of-fact confirmation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検事の川島様と公判前協議もされますね
lines.en: And they're having pre-trial discussions with prosecutor Kawashima as well, I hear?
lines.style: Slightly warmer shift — acknowledging inter-agency collaboration. Softer than the earlier lines. Still professional but with a touch more familiarity at the close.
